stagingLines: [d79] 🍲 Nora is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
[d79] ◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

[d79] 👑 Speakers from Thornfield, The Red Table, Stonebridge ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
[d79] 📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
[d79] A frightened family cries — relief, mostly. Haven grows by one.
[d79] 👋 The village didn't wait for you — a frightened family was taken in around the fire. Another pair of hands.
[d79] That night, they bring Lena home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
[d79] A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

followLines: [d81] — DAY 81 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
[d81] Overnight, Blackberry went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
[d81] Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
[d81] The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. Aisha mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)
[d81] 👀 Someone asks Priya a shop-talk question about EMT work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
[d81] 👀 "ER nurse, huh?" Theo nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no ER nurse would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
[d81] 📓 Codex: A person, maybe 50s — jotted down what they said. Filed.
[d81] 🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
[d81] "The System flagged your sector. Move. NOW."
[d81] (436 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
[d81] 💬 Priya says: "Someone's been leaving food out. Good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."

[d81] No risky water to boil.
[d81] Drank clean water.
